description:
Create an electrical schematic for a 'Transistor LED Driver' circuit in Wondershare EdrawMax. 

Starting from a blank drawing, open the Electrical Engineering libraries and place the following components:
1. A 9V DC Voltage Source (Label: '9V')
2. A Switch (Label: 'SW1')
3. A Resistor connected to the switch (Label: '1k')
4. An NPN Transistor (Label: '2N2222')
5. An LED (Label: 'Status LED')
6. A current-limiting Resistor for the LED (Label: '330R')
7. A Ground connection (Label: 'GND')

Wire them as follows:
- 9V (+) -> SW1 -> 1k Resistor -> Transistor Base
- 9V (+) -> 330R Resistor -> LED Anode
- LED Cathode -> Transistor Collector
- Transistor Emitter -> Ground
- 9V (-) -> Ground

Add a title text 'NPN LED Driver Schematic' at the top.

Save the schematic as '/home/ga/Diagrams/led_driver_schematic.eddx' and export it as an image to '/home/ga/Diagrams/led_driver_schematic.png'.
